build_insertion_transformer_model: build an InsertionTransformerModel with encoder and decoder for non-autoregressive translation
build_insertion_transformer_decoder: build an InsertionTransformerDecoder to predict word insertions using the forward_word_ins method
compute_negative_distance_score: compute a negative distance score for insertion label weighting using NegativeDistanceScore
get_insertion_targets: get insertion target tensors from input and output token sequences using _get_ins_targets
apply_inserted_words: apply predicted inserted words and scores to output tokens using _apply_ins_words
